generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The `foldable()` method returns `true` when a condition's folded value is an instance of `List` (indicating a multi-valued field). However, a multi-valued field cannot be reduced to a constant boolean value at compile time. Furthermore, the `fold()` override for `Case` has been removed (#Z090K), meaning any attempt to fold this expression after `foldable()` returns `true` will result in a `QlIllegalArgumentException` from the base class. This should return `false` or allow the loop to continue evaluating other conditions.

review_comment: I've given us a little more flexibility, specifically so I can tell folks that multivalues in CASE default to `false`. If it's confusing why we do that read the PR description. Er, well, it's still confusing a bit. But that tries to explain it.
I think CASE is the only function that has this funny signature. It's actually pretty helpful to see the railroad diagram for CASE too!
These were missing and easy enough to add while I was here.
